# Kwontified

> Kwontified is an independent ecommerce agency that runs Amazon, Walmart, Target Plus and global marketplaces for consumer brands. One senior team owns advertising, creative, operations and analytics, measured on sales, return on ad spend and margin.

Kwontified LLC. Founded 2016. Offices: Atlanta (headquarters), New York, Seattle. Contact: hello@kwontified.com, 404.873.9148. Serves the US, Canada, the UK and the EU.

## Capabilities
- [Retail Media and Advertising](https://kwontified.com/capabilities/retail-media): Amazon Ads, Amazon DSP and Amazon Marketing Cloud, Walmart Connect, Target Roundel, Meta and TikTok, judged on incremental return rather than attributed clicks.
- [Creative Studio](https://kwontified.com/capabilities/creative-studio): product photography, video, AI image and video, A+ Content and Storefronts, briefed from conversion data.
- [Marketplace Operations](https://kwontified.com/capabilities/marketplace-operations): catalog, inventory, 1P and 3P account management, promotions and compliance.
- [Analytics and Forecasting](https://kwontified.com/capabilities/analytics): dashboards, audits, and sales, budget and inventory forecasts in conservative, standard and reach scenarios.
- [AI Commerce](https://kwontified.com/capabilities/ai-commerce): structuring product data and content so Amazon Rufus, ChatGPT, Google Gemini and Claude can read, trust and recommend the brand.
- [Revenue Recovery](https://kwontified.com/capabilities/revenue-recovery): shortage, price-claim and chargeback audits and disputes for vendor accounts.

## Channels
Amazon, Amazon brand programs (Vine, Premium Beauty, Luxury Stores, Creator Connections), Walmart, Target Plus, International (Canada, Mexico, UK, EU), Zalando, Mercado Libre, Temu, TikTok Shop, Instagram Shop.

## Representative results
- $1.8M from Amazon DSP at 9.4x ROAS on $192K of spend for a national beauty brand, with new-to-brand sales up 28% and search ROAS held.
- A premium skincare brand's conversion lifted from 8.2% to 12.1% on the same ad budget, worth $4.2M in incremental revenue.
- $14.0M annual revenue on a Vendor Central account after fixing chargebacks, fill rates and shortage claims (PO fill rate 71% to 92%).
